correctness.rationale: The source definitions and disputed proof step were reconstructed from the primary full text. The field phi is H-valued and measurable, its analysis operator is exactly M A, and Plancherel gives the weak A-frame equality. Any Bessel weak A-dual would have analysis operator C_psi satisfying A=C_phi^* C_psi. Since C_phi^*=A M^* is injective and A=C_phi^* M, one gets C_psi=M. Fourier basis coordinates then all have modulus one almost everywhere on a common full-measure set, contradicting square summability of the coordinates of psi_x.

value.rationale: Theorem 3.20 is a central characterization of continuous weak A-frames and weak atomic systems. The counterexample breaks the advertised existence of Bessel weak A-duals on the canonical nonatomic coefficient space [0,1], while retaining an exact Parseval-type weak A-frame identity. The repair isolates a genuine structural boundary between arbitrary bounded L2 factors and pointwise vector-analysis operators, with a concrete Hilbert--Schmidt sufficient condition and a discrete safe case.
